text:
maria: Pushed a compact snapshot of the cache hitline dashboard to Grafana — focused view for quick triage by model/route/customer. Link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/prefix-compact

ryan: saw the alert this morning. rough numbers? overall hit % and token-saved rate?

maria: overall hit ~18% across prod for gptj-6b on chat-route, token-saved ~1.2M tokens/day after warmup. per-customer skew: top 3 tenants account for 70% of hits.

amit: interesting — I profiled kernel selection during the high-hit windows and saw increased small-batch kernels kicking in. suspecting batching heuristic: when prefix cache hits spike, effective batch sizes drop and we fall back to lower-throughput kernels which hurts throughput.

claire: can you paste the profiling snippet? want to correlate with the KV cache eviction logs.

amit: sure — snippet from perf trace: ```
# trace sample
model=gptj-6b route=chat-route
time=2026-07-12T10:42:03Z
batch_effective=4 -> kernel=matmul_small_opt
batch_effective=32 -> kernel=matmul_large_opt
kv_hit_ratio=0.21
cpu_ms_per_token=1.8 -> 3.4 when small kernel used
```

maria: that matches what the compact dashboard shows: spikes in per-route hit% correlate with latency tail rising. I added a per-route token-saved sparkline and a kernel-selection tag to help triage.

ryan: opsbot showed a regression alert yesterday morning for chat-route — opsbot, what was the detection rule?

opsbot: ALERT 2265432050: rolling increase in p95 latency by >15% over 10m for route=chat-route. linked panels: prefix_hit_pct, kernel_selector, batch_size_dist.

claire: action items: 1) add an annotation layer for warmup-backfill jobs so we can exclude scheduled backfills, 2) experiment with forcing batch-min=8 on chat-route during high-hit windows, 3) add a tenant-slice panel to the compact view.

maria: will add annotations and tenant-slice. ryan/amit can you run an A/B with batch-min tweak on a canary pool? we should measure token-saved delta vs p95.

ryan: will run canary this afternoon. logging expected metrics to /tmp/cache-ab-test.csv and will post short summary here. :thumbsup:

amit: will also dump kernel decision logs for the canary. if forcing batch-min reduces kernel switches and lowers p95 without sacrificing token-saved too much, we can bake a routing policy change.

maria: thanks — added quick TODOs on the dashboard and pinned the panels. if anyone sees new weirdness, reply here and I'll attach screenshots.
